description: This file defines the ClassInfo class, representing metadata about Java classes or interfaces within the Android APK analysis tool. It includes fields for class name, superclass, interfaces, methods, fields, and functions for flattening class hierarchy information.

classes.name: ClassInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata about a Java class or interface, including its name, methods, fields, superclass, interfaces, and attributes related to enumeration and annotations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class.

methods.name: getSuperclassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the superclass.

methods.name: getStatic
methods.description: Returns the static attribute of the class as a string ('true', 'false', or null).

methods.name: isEnum
methods.description: Checks if this class is an enumerated type.

methods.name: isAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if this class is an annotation type.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a FieldInfo object to the class's field list.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a field by its name and type.

methods.name: getFieldIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all fields.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Adds a MethodInfo object to the class's method list.

methods.name: getMethodIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all methods.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a method by its name and descriptor.

methods.name: getMethodIgnoringReturn
methods.description: Retrieves a method matching the name and parameter part of the descriptor, ignoring return type differences.

methods.name: hasNoFieldMethod
methods.description: Checks if the class has no fields or methods.

methods.name: addInterface
methods.description: Adds an interface name to the list of interfaces implemented by the class.

methods.name: flattenClass
methods.description: Flattens class hierarchy by copying fields and methods from superclasses and interfaces into this class.

methods.name: normalizeTypes
methods.description: Normalizes type names in fields and methods to ensure consistency.

methods.name: mergeFrom
methods.description: Merges fields and methods from another ClassInfo instance into this one.

methods.name: lookupClass
methods.description: Private static method to locate ClassInfo in ApiList by fully-qualified name.
